हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description:
This is a survival thriller where a group of people are trapped in deadly, game-like scenarios orchestrated by a masked tormentor called Jallad.
Amidst betrayals, psychological manipulation, and gruesome eliminations, the characters are forced to expose their darkest secrets and confront past crimes. The story unfolds as a tense battle of wits, morality, and survival, with truth and guilt deciding who lives and who perishes . Watch now.
